entities.name: Al-Hayat
entities.description: A rare ancient talking wolf of Mirrodin who opposed the levelers and helped Glissa, and died after the battle.

entities.name: Glissa
entities.description: Helped by Al-Hayat in opposing Memnarch's tyranny.

entities.name: Slobad
entities.description: Buried alive by a beetle and rescued with Al-Hayat's help.

entities.name: Memnarch
entities.description: Tyrant of Mirrodin opposed by Glissa and Al-Hayat.

entities.name: Kaldra Champion
entities.description: Assembled in the Vault of Whispers; rained destruction on the Vedalken and levelers.

entities.name: Mephidross
entities.description: Where the group set off for.

entities.name: Vault of Whispers
entities.description: Where the Kaldra Champion was assembled.

events.summary: With Al-Hayat's help Glissa finds Slobad; the wolf vows to help rid Mirrodin of Memnarch.
events.quote: Al-Hayat vowed to help Glissa rid Mirrodin of Memnarch's reign of tyranny.

events.summary: In the Vault of Whispers they assemble the Kaldra Champion, which wins the battle against the Vedalken and levelers.
events.quote: In the Vault of Whispers thay assembled the Kaldra Champion which rained destruction on the Vedalken and levelers alike.

events.summary: Al-Hayat dies of mortal wounds after the victory, bidding Glissa to liberate Mirrodin from Memnarch.
events.quote: With the last of his energy, the ancient wolf bade Glissa to liberate Mirrodin from Memnarch.

relations.note: He vowed to help her against Memnarch.
relations.quote: Al-Hayat vowed to help Glissa rid Mirrodin of Memnarch's reign of tyranny.
it was through the intervention of his diminished race that the myr and Memnarch ’s other servants did not enter the Tangle
